objective: Add the command structure of the atlas-ai binary, the Linux and Windows platform paths it owns, and CI that runs vet and tests on both platforms.
problem: The repository has only the shipped skills and their contract test. Roadmap features 4 to 11 need a binary with commands, a place for atlas-ai's own state, and a CI that proves it works on Windows.
scope: internal/cli dispatcher with help, version and paths commands (stdlib flag, no new dependencies)
internal/platform path resolver for linux and windows (home and state directory)
CI matrix ubuntu-latest and windows-latest with go vet and go test
constraints: Never build after changes; verification uses go test and go vet only
No new dependencies: stdlib flag only (user decision of 2026-11-11)
Agent configuration paths are out of scope; they belong to agent-adapters-skills and are Unverified on Windows
Empty or relative environment values are rejected; no fallback to the current directory

tdd.source: explicit user approval of the cli-skeleton plan (2026-11-11), same mode as neutral-skills

route: mixed; per-task route recorded on each task

tasks.description: Platform paths: internal/platform/paths_test.go first (linux with and without XDG_STATE_HOME, relative XDG ignored, empty HOME error; windows USERPROFILE and LOCALAPPDATA, missing variables error; unsupported GOOS error), observe RED, then internal/platform/paths.go with Paths{Home, StateDir} and Resolve(goos, getenv).
tasks.reason: A pure resolver keeps both platforms testable on one host. Rejecting empty and relative values is the secure default. Route: delegated writer (writer trigger, T1 and T2 touch 2+ non-trivial files).
tasks.evidence: RED: undefined Paths/Resolve (build failed). GREEN: go test ./internal/platform ok. Re-run by the parent: go vet clean, go test -count=1 ./... 54 passed in 4 packages, gofmt clean, go.mod/go.sum unchanged. Route: delegated writer.

tasks.reason: Stdlib flag per user decision. Injected writers and environment make the CLI testable without building. Route: delegated writer (same writer as T1).
tasks.evidence: RED: undefined Env/Run (build failed). GREEN: go test ./internal/cli ok. Same full-suite re-run by the parent. Route: delegated writer.

tasks.reason: The roadmap requires tests on Linux and Windows. The skills contract test already normalizes CRLF. Route: inline (single mechanical file).
tasks.evidence: ci.yml parses; matrix ubuntu-latest and windows-latest, vet step before test. Real run pending in the pull request. Route: inline.
